nvitk.measure._common
=====================

.. py:module:: nvitk.measure._common

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Internal helpers shared by the measure primitives.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.measure._common.resolve_array
   nvitk.measure._common.resolve_spacing
   nvitk.measure._common.bool_mask
   nvitk.measure._common.ensure_same_shape


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: resolve_array(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> Any

   Return the voxel array for *img*, or *img* itself when already an array.


.. py:function:: resolve_spacing(img: nvitk.types.Image | Any, spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None) -> tuple[float, Ellipsis]

   Return a spacing tuple for *img*.

   Resolution order:
   1. explicit *spacing* argument;
   2. ``img.spacing`` when *img* is an :class:`Image`;
   3. :class:`ValueError`.


.. py:function:: bool_mask(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> Any

   Boolean-cast *mask* preserving backend (NumPy/CuPy).


.. py:function:: ensure_same_shape(a: nvitk.types.Image | Any, b: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> None

   Raise ``ValueError`` unless *a* and *b* (Image or array) have the same shape.
